summary: Single topic with a genuine path to §3.1's restriction-map clause, but three of the four stages the roadmap places before that clause are still absent from main and unrepresented by an open PR, and no restriction map exists for these laws to govern. Land it behind the A_U⁺/Huber-pair/presentation-isomorphism work.
